task: Implement an INIT-to-INIT_CHECK scope anti-expansion gate for Lattice stories.
outcome: After creating a correctness-fix story with excluded future keywords, the user sees `Cannot enter INIT_CHECK: scope freeze failed [excluded_keyword_in_checklist]` before any worktree is created; after providing an explicit boundary and clean checklist, `lattice story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK` succeeds and reports the worktree path.
facts: Current init-check signing covers background/title/description/checklist after init_check_set, but does not preserve the original user boundary before reviewer influence.
Current scope-contract/prewrite guard protects changed files later in PLAN/DEV/REVIEW, not semantic scope expansion before worktree creation.
INIT reviewers are reviewerWrite lanes and must not mutate checklist/scope directly.
Gate-consumed process facts must be registered in process-fact-levels and process-fact-registry, with contract verification updated.
The local OMX ban remains active; no .omx path may be used for runtime artifacts, baselines, logs, or evidence.
constraints: All story and checklist metadata changes must go through Lattice CLI, not direct story-file edits.
Failures must happen before worktree creation when blocking INIT_CHECK.
Missing scope boundary must fail closed; absence cannot mean whole-project scope.
Default future denylist applies only to correctness_fix mode; other modes rely on user-confirmed excluded scope/keywords.
Scope extension must be proposal plus explicit decision, not reviewer checklist mutation.
